Name: Kiln Recipe Modifier
Author: swemoney
Description:
This is a really simple mod that changes the amount of wood required for a Charcoal Kiln to create a piece of coal. By default, the mod changes the wood required from 10 pieces to 5 pieces. You can customize the amount after your load Stardew Valley for the first time by editing the config.json to whatever value you want.

Install the mod by unpacking and placing the "[CP] Kiln Recipe Modifier" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.

After you run Stardew Valley for the first time with the mod installed, a "config.json" file will be created inside the mod's folder that you can edit to change the amount of wood required to make coal.

Enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Kiln Recipe Modifier
Manifest.Description: Modifies how much wood is required for the kiln to produce coal.
